project.name: Credex AI Spend Audit
project.purpose: End-to-end test specification for the assignment deliverable.
project.note: This is a specification/checklist JSON, not an execution report. Actual pass/fail must be verified against the repo and deployed app.

assignment_requirements.git_history_rule: Commits on at least 5 distinct calendar days within the 7-day window.
assignment_requirements.backend_requirement: Stored in a real backend such as Supabase/Firebase/D1/Postgres.
assignment_requirements.ai_requirement: Use Anthropic API or any LLM for the personalized summary; handle failure gracefully.
assignment_requirements.security_requirement: Basic abuse protection such as rate limiting, honeypot, or hCaptcha.
assignment_requirements.share_requirement: Unique public URL with Open Graph tags and no identifying details exposed.

layers: Unit tests: audit engine, pricing logic, helpers, validation
Integration tests: API routes, database writes, AI fallback, email sending abstraction
End-to-end tests: user journey from landing page to public share URL
Security tests: RLS, no secret leakage, abuse protection
Accessibility and SEO checks: heading structure, form labels, OG tags

test_files_to_create.purpose: Validate plan-fit logic, downgrade suggestions, savings math, and edge cases.
Validate every required tool and plan exists with current numeric pricing and source metadata.
Validate form input constraints, required fields, min/max values, and empty-state behavior.
Validate AI summary fallback when the model/API fails or returns invalid output.
Validate backend policy assumptions and that sensitive lead data is not publicly readable.
Validate audit creation endpoint, response shape, persistence, and error handling.
Validate lead capture writes, optional fields, honeypot/rate-limit rejection, and transactional email hooks.
Validate landing page -> form -> audit result -> lead gate -> share URL flow.
Validate public audit page metadata, title, description, and social preview tags.
Validate form labels, button names, heading order, and no critical accessibility violations.

test_matrix.title: Calculates savings for a single over-provisioned tool
expect: returns a recommended cheaper plan or alternative
reason is one sentence and defensible

test_matrix.title: Does not manufacture savings when user is already optimal
expect: result says already optimal or low savings
monthly savings is 0 or below threshold
hero copy does not overstate savings

test_matrix.title: Credits/direct API path is recommended only when cheaper and defensible
expect: only suggests credits/direct API if supported by pricing logic

test_matrix.title: Rejects invalid team size and negative spend
Persists form state across reloads
expect: reload retains selected tools and plans

test_matrix.title: Falls back cleanly when AI provider fails
expect: error is logged or surfaced for observability

test_matrix.title: Creates audit record and returns public share ID
Captures email after value is shown
expect: lead is stored only after audit is visible
email is required, optional company/role/team size accepted
public audit payload excludes private fields

test_matrix.title: Cold visitor can complete the full audit flow
High-savings cases prominently surface Credex consultation
expect: Credex CTA visible above the fold
copy frames consultation as next step

test_matrix.title: Low-savings cases are honest
expect: copy says spending is already good or close to optimal
lead capture still works via notification signup

test_matrix.title: Public audit page has OG and Twitter card metadata
Main form is accessible with labels and keyboard interaction

edge_cases: Zero spend but valid use case
Public share URL with deleted/private fields

jenkins_pipeline.note: GitHub Actions is sufficient for the assignment, but Jenkins can mirror the same gates if you want an extra CI signal.
